name: Cork & Curve
tagline: Verified vineyards, tasting rooms, wine bars and wine festivals across 37 European wine regions
description: A public, read-only remote MCP server over Cork & Curve's editorially verified wine travel data. Every venue carries provenance (source URL, date checked, open status) and opening hours; wine festivals come with resolved dates; tours and stays are bookable through affiliate links. Ten tools: `search_places`, `place`, `plan_day`, `festivals`, `experiences`, `stays`, `car_hire`, `dishes`, `itineraries` and `cities`. No key or sign-up is needed. Terms: pass booking links to users unchanged and say they are affiliate links, cite the `page` URL, do not bulk-copy the catalogue (https://corkandcurve.com/agents/).

install.notes: Hosted remote server, no authentication. The same functions are available as REST with OpenAPI at https://corkandcurve.com/api/v1/docs.
